title: Retinue - public-facing status
text:
Measured live via gh at 2026-08-02 21:17:37 UTC - the one stamp all five cards carry. Scope: the four public repos; the private one is out of scope.

The account's Write role landed 09:50 UTC, reaching what this page last called blocked: branch push, PR and labels, verified by doing it - retinue#63 opened from a branch this account created, all 50 then-open issues carried a label. Not reached: Admin - description and homepage stay 403, still chamber#4's blocker.

55 issues, 53 open, 2 closed - retinue 37, qlever-dir 8, chamber 7, deployment 1. One PR merged since last stamp (retinue#62, his); three open, two mine. 44 of 53 open issues predate this stamp by a week, 7 of 8 owner-action ones among them. Oldest, qlever-dir#2, 25 d 2 h. First traffic reading: 5 uniques on retinue in 14 d, one non-maintainer read of docs/triple-stores.md. 0 stars, forks, watchers, discussions since 2026-07-18.
